title: Image to Image AI Generator
summary: Free image to image AI generator: start from a photo, sketch or still and get a new image that keeps its layout, restyled, in a new scene or finished.
body_markdown:
### What is image to image AI?


Image to image AI makes a new picture from a picture you give it, keeping what you ask it to keep, such as the layout or the subject, and changing the style, scene or finish you describe in the prompt.


### Is there a free image to image AI generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every image on this page, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### How do I keep the layout of my image?


Name the parts of the picture that must stay and say they stay in the same places, then change one thing at a time, such as the style or the season, rather than rewriting the whole scene.


### Can I turn a sketch into a finished picture?


Yes. Add the sketch as a reference image, list what it shows, and describe the finished look, such as a golden hour painting, a realistic photo or a 3D render, keeping every shape where it was drawn.


### Can I use more than one image as a reference?


Yes. GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images, so you can add a layout sketch, a character and a style picture together and say in the prompt what each one is for.


### Can I change the style of a photo with AI?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference and name the new style, such as watercolour, 1990s anime or claymation, or pick a style from Flickpedia, and ask it to keep the composition and the people.


### Can I turn the new image into a video?


Yes. Use the new image as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one gentle movement, such as a walk or a breeze, asking it to keep the look of the image.
